Results.ReviewText: I have always had a Weber grill.  In fact, my wife and I got our first Weber charcoal grill with Green Stamps.  I have only used two grills and both were the 22 inch kettle grillsl.  However, I am 73 now and buying charcoal, fluid, getting it started, and waiting for the  coals to ash over to grill, and then having to get rid of the ashes has become too much.  Anyway, I decided to treat myself to a new gas grill and it had to be a Weber..  I am thrilled with the Spirit II E-210.  It;s so easy, so fast, so reliable, so well constructed.  This is one of the best decisions I've ever made.  Actually, with the warranty it's an investment.  I wish I had done this a few years ago.  I am sure the grill will last longer than I will.
Results.Title: Best thing I have done in a long time.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Weber Quality shows in this unit. It replaced a larger grill of another brand but this is still large enough to grill medium sized steaks for 8 people plus.  This was more money but you get what you pay for.  The instructions are accurate and the time to assemble wasn’t as long as indicated but if you can buy with assembly included a time saver.  The grates are heavy duty and is a well built grill.  The grilling works well no flare ups but depends on your grilling ability more than the grill itself. Igniter seems to well designed and built to last. I love the small replacement drip trays instead of having to clean one.  The only reason not a 5 star is the adjustable shelf on the LH side doesn’t allow for easy moving the grill. It is a real pain to move because there is no good way to grab it with the way the shelf is mounted to fold down for storage. I am not going to invest in the wireless cooking probe system based on reviews on how it works and cost. Bought this end of summer season on sale but would still be worth the full price based on quality.  I was surprised on the 10 year warranty but doesn’t look like it will be needed.  I also like the online grilling tips and emails.  Would buy again but I think this will last me past retirement.
Results.Title: Weber Quality Worth It

Results.ReviewText:
I would give the grill 5 stars if it weren't for the issues I encountered assembling it and the poor customer service.

This grill was ordered for me as a gift on 9/2 and delivered 9/11 and there was $40 shipping charge When the grill arrived, there was no apparent damage to the package and no scratches or markings on the parts inside indicating any damage occurred during packaging or shipping.  My mother purchased the exact same grill from Amazon in May for the same price and free two-day shipping.  I had assembled the grill for her, so I knew it was not a simple task, but it was not extremely difficult either.  She really likes her grill, which is why the same one was purchase for me.

When I began assembling the grill, I noticed that one part of the frame could not be inserted to the base as one entire side was misshapen; again there were no scratches or markings on the piece to indicate it was damaged, so there was no way for me to know there was an issue until I began the assembly.  Since there are no indications of damage, I can only conclude that parts of the grill are defective.  I called Weber and was on hold for more than 30 minutes.  When I finally got thru to a representative (who was not at all friendly), I was told I would be sent an e-mail, which I was, and to respond with a photo of the defective part.  I responded within hours of receiving the e-mail and then after 3 days of assuming the part was being replaced, I received another e-mail stating that the photo couldn’t be opened.  I immediately re-sent the photo and received the replacement part a week later.  I went back to work to assemble the grill, only to find out that the part off the frame on the opposite side was also defective.  Again, since there are no scratches or markings on the part to indicate it’s been damaged, I didn’t know that there was an issue until I began to, once again, assemble the grill.  I had had the parts of the grill laid out on a blanket on my living room floor thinking it would be an hour or two process to assemble the grill seeing as I had done it before, not weeks!  If I could have easily removed the parts of the grill from the packaging without having to destroy the box, I would have sent the entire grill back and never purchased a Weber grill again.   I cannot express how disappointing and frustrating this has been.
Results.Title: I will never purchase directly from Weber again!

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
